dct_description_sm: The surface water quality monitoring sampling conducted by Eastern Charlotte Waterways with the support of the Environmental Trust Fund in the outer Bay of Fundy Watershed in Southern New Brunswick collected data on surface water quality was designed to compliment data from existing federal DELG surface water quality sampling by conducting additional sampling at existing sites.
dct_title_s: Eastern Charlotte Waterways: 2018 Freshwater Quality Data from the Outer Bay of Fundy Watershed Complex
